Plugin.Name: Chronostasis
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: docker templates old settings upgrade compare template changes renamed fields backup
Plugin.Overview:
Unraid keeps your own copy of a Docker template when you install an app: your old settings. Community Applications templates keep moving, and nothing tells you.
Chronostasis compares old settings with the template in Community Applications and asks about each difference.
- New fields, renamed fields, new images and new addresses, app by app. - Upgrade: opens the upgraded settings in Unraid's form, with your values kept. Nothing happens to a container until you press Apply there. - Report: a text you can give the template's author, with no values in it. - Keeps a backup of your old settings before an upgrade, and you can go back.
A difference is not always a problem, and the template can be the older side. It sends nothing.
